title: Figure 20: Biodegradable CSLG polymer printed in honeycomb scaffold blocks
description: Photograph of two translucent tan cube-shaped polymer scaffolds with a regular grid of pores, shown on a black background. Caption: "Figure 20. Biodegradable Material CSLG Deposited in a Honeycomb Structure to Allow Infiltration by Living Cells While in a Submerged Cell Culture." The text describes ink-jet-like layer deposition of CSLA polymer and introduces 'Cardiovascular Biomaterials'.
